definitions.explanation: Referring to a reciprocal relationship or action between two or more parties.

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}いましょう→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧。
examples.notes: お互いに = mutually, each other (polite)

examples.japanese: {互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: It's the same for both of us. / We're in the same boat.

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}おう→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧。
examples.english: Let's keep in touch with each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It is important for married couples to understand each other's feelings.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: Mutually, each other (adverbial)
- {互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: Each other's (noun)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: We're in the same situation (expression)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to understand each other)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}う→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧ (to help each other)
- ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to respect each other)

NOTE: The prefix お is commonly added for politeness (⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{互|たが}い), though {互|たが}い alone is also used.
